references.text: The priest shall examine the disease and declare the person unclean—the same procedure for determining uncleanness in skin diseases
The priest declares the person unclean when leprosy breaks out—parallel to the priest's role in declaring uncleanness
The man is unclean due to leprosy on the head—the same conclusion regarding uncleanness in chronic leprosy
The cleansing ritual for a leprous person—shows the process of becoming clean again after being declared unclean
Miriam is struck with leprosy and must be isolated outside the camp—an example of leprosy and uncleanness in practice
Reminder to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy—reference to the laws in Leviticus
Naaman's leprosy passes to Gehasi—illustrates the seriousness of leprosy as God's judgment
